note: HF chain correction v2 (NonLin_program 11.6): complex log-gain at knots_hz per capture, exp(z) applied to the model above 10 kHz (unity <= 10 kHz and >= 12.8 kHz); `skip`: no correction. z = z0 + s u, shape from the other capture runs, s from the R front taps weighted by a 5-minute Gaussian in time; skip where the 15 nearest front-tap estimates scatter above the library's 90th percentile (0.0164). Captures without a timestamp: `default` (the all-run mean).
